verdict.rationale: A state tax agency could plausibly offer a system-to-system channel such as an e-file transmitter or batch-provider program, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only two probes recording Akamai 403 denials at robots.txt and the webapp host. Neither documents any system accounts, transmitter program, batch-provider channel, or published enrollment path, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
